suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-18: CVE-2025-45770 concerns the PHP package lcobucci/jwt, not the Python package PyJWT. Dependency-Check 13.0.0 incorrectly maps pkg:pypi/pyjwt@2.15.1 to cpe:2.3:a:jwt_project:jwt (LOW confidence). This exception covers only this exact Python package/version and CVE. Evidence: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-45770 Product referenced by the CVE: https://github.com/lcobucci/jwt Actual package: https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt
